engine: Kokoro-82M (open model, Apache-2.0 licence, run locally)
why: Kokoro has no child voices; af_heart is the warm American female voice the owner kept for Pip from Nov 3 to Nov 27, 2026. The owner can pick another from samples; then run record.py --speaker zuri --all.
how_it_works: Same as Pip (voice.json): record.py --speaker zuri lists everything Zuri says from the app (her skills GE and MS, her hello, the shared praise and clue lines), records the missing clips into narration/audio-zuri as zuri-N.mp3 sprites plus map.json; build.js embeds the map and copies the sprites into dist/audio.
disclosure: Zuri tells children her voice is made by a computer, as Pip does.
